author: S. T. Grossman
title: Mark Walter to sell Lakers to Josh Kushner and Bob Iger for over $12 billion
text:
Mark Walter to sell Lakers to Josh Kushner and Bob Iger for over $12 billion
The Los Angeles Lakers are being sold by Mark Walter to businessmen Josh Kushner and Bob Iger for a record-breaking price of over $12 billion, according to multiple sources cited by ESPN on Aug. 12. This marks the second time in a year that the storied NBA franchise has changed hands at a record valuation.
Walter, CEO of TWC Global and owner of the L.A. Dodgers, purchased the Lakers from Jeanie Buss and her family just one year ago for $10 billion with plans to overhaul the organization. However, he is now stepping away from those plans as he finalizes this new sale.
Josh Kushner was previously a minority owner of the Miami Heat and is founder and managing partner of Thrive Capital as well as co-founder and vice-chairman of Oscar Health. Bob Iger is known for his tenure as CEO of The Walt Disney Company from 2005-2020 and again from 2022-2026 before stepping down earlier this year.
In a statement provided to ESPN, Kushner and Iger said, “As lifelong NBA fans, we are deeply honored for the opportunity to become stewards of the Los Angeles Lakers, one of the most iconic sports franchises in the world. We have immense respect for the leadership and vision of Jerry…”
Walter also issued a statement through ESPN, “Owning the Los Angeles Lakers has been one of the great honors of my life – an extraordinary investment, but what I will carry with me is the community, the fans, and a city that treats this team as family. I am grateful to Jeanie Buss…”
It remains unclear whether Jeanie Buss will continue in her role as Governor or if Rob Pelinka will remain running basketball operations under new ownership. While Walter did not specify his reasons for selling in his statement, reports indicate investigations into some companies he owns regarding potential financial improprieties, along with concerns about his health following a stroke during the Dodgers’ World Series run in 2024.
summary: Walter, CEO of TWC Global and owner of the L.A. Dodgers, purchased the Lakers from Jeanie Buss and her family just one year ago for $10 billion with plans to overhaul the organization. Josh Kushner was previously a minority owner of the Miami Heat and is founder and managing partner of Thrive Capital as well as co-founder and vice-chairman of Oscar Health.
